notes: Refined openspec's 8 parent ACs into 11. Changes: (1) Replaced 'apiKey stored as private field' with observable outcome 'not accessible as a public property' — private field is implementation. (2) Replaced vague 'specified fields' with explicit field enumeration for both interfaces — untestable without listing fields. (3) Expanded apiKey-leak prevention from HTTP errors only to all error paths (HTTP, parse, network). (4) Added empty response body and extra-fields-accepted cases to parse-error AC — these are distinct edge cases. (5) Enumerated specific non-'true' MOCK_SKYSCANNER_API values instead of 'any other value' — prevents fuzzy truthy interpretation. (6) Added network-level fetch error AC — openspec only covered HTTP errors, not fetch rejections. (7) Added security AC requiring API key in headers only, never query params — prevents credential exposure in logs/URLs. (8) Added test-file coverage AC consolidating test requirements as observable outcomes rather than implementation instructions.

splitStories.title: Server core setup, health endpoint, static dashboard serving, and RAPIDAPI_KEY middleware
splitStories.description: Create the Express app in src/server.ts with guarded listen(), export named `app`, implement GET /health, GET / (serving src/public/index.html from file at runtime), and RAPIDAPI_KEY absence middleware that short-circuits /search and /cheapest with 503. acceptanceCriteria: src/server.ts exports a named `app` (Express instance) separately from the `listen()` call; listen() is guarded (ESM: import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href or CJS: require.main === module) so importing `app` in tests never binds a port
GET /health returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/json and body { status: 'ok', uptime: <positive number> }; this endpoint is never gated by RAPIDAPI_KEY presence

GET / returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/html and body equal to contents of src/public/index.html read from that file at runtime (fs.readFileSync or equivalent); a hardcoded inline HTML string is not acceptable; this route is never gated by RAPIDAPI_KEY

src/public/index.html exists as a styled single-page dashboard with: (a) full-width solid blue (#1a73e8) header bar with bold white title 'Skyscanner Dashboard' and subtitle; (b) centered white card (max-width ~700px, rounded corners, light border, padding) with 2-column grid search form — row 1: From (IATA) and To (IATA) text inputs with labels, row 2: Date (native date input) and Adults (number input, default 1) with labels; (c) full-width blue 'Search Flights' button; (d) status area: light-red/pink banner with red text for errors, muted-gray line for empty results, result count on success; (e) client-side JS: form submits via GET /search without page reload, disables button during request, renders flights into results table

The FlightResult type used in src/server.ts is imported from the SKY-002 type export (e.g. src/skyscanner/client.ts) and not redeclared inline
Server reads PORT from env (default 3000) and RAPIDAPI_KEY from env, passing RAPIDAPI_KEY to SkyscannerClient constructor
The file path used by the GET / route handler resolves correctly both under tsx src/server.ts (dev) and node dist/server.js (built) — e.g. using path.resolve relative to import.meta.url or __dirname

splitStories.title: API route handlers for /search and /cheapest with validation and error handling
splitStories.description: Implement GET /search and GET /cheapest route handlers in src/server.ts with query param validation, SkyscannerClient integration, cheapest-flight selection, and error handling. /search returns flights array with count and searchedAt timestamp; /cheapest returns the single cheapest flight or 404. Both handle missing/invalid params with 400, and SkyscannerClient errors with 500. Depends on SKY-004-A for app skeleton, middleware, and type imports.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /search with valid from/to/date (adults optional, default 1) returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/json and body { flights: FlightResult[], count: number, searchedAt: ISO-8601 string } where count strictly equals flights.length

GET /search missing any required param (from, to, or date) returns HTTP 400 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string }; non-numeric adults value (e.g. 'abc', '') also returns 400 { error: string }; absent adults defaults to 1 and returns 200

GET /cheapest with valid from/to/date returns HTTP 200 with a single FlightResult whose price field is ≤ every FlightResult returned by SkyscannerClient for the same route/date; if adults is supplied it is forwarded, if absent it defaults to 1
GET /cheapest returns HTTP 404 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string } when SkyscannerClient returns an empty array for the given route/date
GET /cheapest missing any required param (from, to, or date) returns HTTP 400 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string }

When SkyscannerClient throws an error during a /search or /cheapest request (e.g. network failure, upstream 5xx), the server returns HTTP 500 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string } without crashing or emitting an unhandled promise rejection
The searchedAt field in the GET /search response is an ISO-8601 datetime string reflecting the time of the request; successive requests separated by at least 1 ms return distinct values
All /search and /cheapest error responses (400, 404, 500) include Content-Type application/json and body { error: string }
